storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/cropconditions/, one file per FETCH date with event-identity dedup (commodity|week_ending|short_desc) across restarts; gz after 2 days
written_by: server/cropConditions.ts archiveConditions (12h poll, 2 politeness-spaced calls/cycle, eager boot; key-gated on NASS_API_KEY — fredMacro/censusImports pattern)
source: USDA NASS QuickStats API (api_GET) — free key. Keyless probe 2026-07-06 returned unauthorized, so the row shape follows the documented QuickStats contract with defensive parsing (Value/value keys, comma-grouped numbers) and VERBATIM error-body logging (censusImports precedent); LIVE VERIFICATION PENDING post-deploy. field_map.commodity|week_ending|item — event-ident: the same week's condition-class reading never re-archives
field_map.item: QuickStats short_desc verbatim (e.g. 'CORN - CONDITION, MEASURED IN PCT EXCELLENT') — the condition class travels inside it, never re-encoded
field_map.pct: percent value; comma-grouped strings normalized; missing values null, never zero

confidence_model: RAW official weekly survey ratings. The condition-delta hypothesis stays gate-locked: gate 1 = values vs the published Crop Progress report; gate 2 = week-over-week condition delta vs forward grain futures returns. Join partner: the live Drought Monitor stream (belt-weighted ag-stress index).
cadence: weekly source (Monday afternoon ET, in growing season); 12h poll makes off-days a dedup no-op
